NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.TEST_SENT: Test email sent to {{email}}. Check that inbox.
NOTIFICATIONS.TEST_FAILED: The test email could not be sent.
NOTIFICATIONS.MAIL_ON: Email is on — notifications are also emailed, from {{from}}.
NOTIFICATIONS.MAIL_NO_SERVER: Email is switched on but no mail server is set (SMTP_HOST), so nothing is emailed.
NOTIFICATIONS.MAIL_OFF: Email is off — notifications appear in the app only. Set MAIL_ENABLED and the SMTP settings to send email.

AUTH.LOGIN_SUB: Log in to pick up where your journey left off.
AUTH.BRAND_TAGLINE: The quest log for new hires learning AWS, Angular & Express, and our ops tooling — one step at a time.
AUTH.SIGNUP_BRAND_SUB: Create your account and your assigned senior will set you up with your first quest log.
AUTH.SIGNUP_SUB: New employee? You'll join as a Learner — your senior assigns your first journey.
AUTH.SIGNED_OUT: Signed out. See you next time!

USER.TITLE: Users
USER.SUB: Manage accounts and assign learners to the right senior.
USER.NEW_PASSWORD: New password (leave blank to keep current)
USER.SENIOR_HINT: This senior will manage their journeys.
USER.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Set a password for the new account.

JOURNEY.TITLE: Journeys
JOURNEY.SUB: Reusable quest logs your team can assign to new hires.
JOURNEY.NONE_YET_SUB: Create your first journey template to start onboarding new hires.
JOURNEY.ASSIGN_SUB: Choose who should start this journey.
JOURNEY.NO_LEARNERS: No learners available to assign yet.
JOURNEY.DELETE_MESSAGE: This removes "{{title}}" and all its quest items. Learners already on it keep their progress, but it can no longer be assigned.
JOURNEY.FORM_SUB: Split the journey into units. Each unit holds the items learners work through in order, and can end with a short quiz.
JOURNEY.SAVE_FIRST_HINT: Save the journey first, then you can add a checkpoint exam.
JOURNEY.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: What will the learner be able to do after this journey?
JOURNEY.ITEM_DESC_PLACEHOLDER: Detailed description — one line per bullet point
JOURNEY.BULLET_TIP: Tip: put each bullet on its own line.
JOURNEY.NO_ITEMS_YET: No quest items yet — add the first one.
JOURNEY.NEEDS_ITEM: Add at least one quest item.
JOURNEY.UNITS_HINT: Learners see these as sections in the journey’s contents.
JOURNEY.UNIT_QUIZ_HINT: Optional. 1–2 multiple-choice or yes/no questions; learners see their result right away.

QUEST_LOG.CANCEL_MESSAGE: The learner's progress on individual items is kept, but the journey will be marked cancelled.

NOTES.EMPTY: No notes yet — leave one for whoever picks this up next.

EXAM.FORM_SUB: Learners unlock this once every quest item is complete. Keep it short.
EXAM.PASSING_HINT: Used as the default pass/fail line when your senior grades it — they can still override.
EXAM.OPEN_NOTE: No correct answer to set — your reviewer marks this correct or incorrect when grading.
EXAM.NO_QUESTIONS: No questions yet — add the first one.
EXAM.REMOVE_MESSAGE: Learners will no longer see an exam step for this journey. Past graded attempts are kept.
EXAM.NO_ACCESS: You don't have access to this exam
EXAM.LOCKED_SUB: This exam opens once every unit is finished — all items done and each unit quiz answered ({{percent}}% of items so far).
EXAM.NO_EXAM_SUB: This journey doesn't have a checkpoint exam configured.
EXAM.AWAITING_SUB: {{name}} hasn't taken this exam yet — check back once they submit.
EXAM.TAKE_SUB: Answer every question, then submit. You can't edit it after submitting.
EXAM.GRADING_SUB: Mark each answer, then submit the grade.
EXAM.SUBMITTED_TOAST: Exam submitted — your senior will review it soon.

DASHBOARD.LEARNER_SUB: Pick up a journey below and keep working through its quest log.
DASHBOARD.NO_JOURNEYS_SUB: Your assigned senior will set up your first quest log soon.

METRICS.LEARNER_SUB: Hours, journeys and exam results across everything you've been assigned.
METRICS.NO_HOURS: No logged hours in this period yet.
METRICS.NO_LEARNERS_SCOPE: No learners in this scope yet.

ATTACHMENT.TITLE: Attachments
ATTACHMENT.STILL_UPLOADING: Wait for the uploads to finish before saving.
ATTACHMENT.INCOMPLETE_SKIPPED: {{count}} attachment(s) are missing a file or URL and will not be saved.
ATTACHMENT.CANNOT_EMBED: Opens in a new tab — this site cannot be embedded.

DEPARTMENT.LABEL: Department
DEPARTMENT.MANAGER_LOCKED: Managers add people to their own department.
DEPARTMENT.TITLE: Departments
DEPARTMENT.SUB: Every person belongs to one department. It decides which manager can see them; journeys stay company-wide.
DEPARTMENT.HAS_MEMBERS: Move its people to another department first.

PACKAGE.TITLE: Packages
PACKAGE.SUB: Bundles of journeys you can assign in one go. Each journey still works on its own.
PACKAGE.NONE_YET_SUB: Bundle journeys you often assign together into a package.
PACKAGE.ASSIGN_SUB: Every journey in the package is assigned. Ones the learner already has are reused, not duplicated.
PACKAGE.CANNOT_DELETE: This package has been assigned, so it can’t be deleted.
PACKAGE.DELETE_MESSAGE: Delete "{{title}}"? The journeys in it are not affected.
PACKAGE.FORM_SUB: Name the package, then pick its journeys and put them in the order learners should take them.
PACKAGE.FUTURE_ONLY: This package is already assigned. Changes apply to future assignments; learners who have it keep what they were given.
PACKAGE.ORDER_HINT: Learners can take them in any order; this order drives the "next journey" button.
PACKAGE.NONE_SELECTED: No journeys yet. Add some below.
PACKAGE.SEARCH_JOURNEYS: Search journeys by title or tag…
PACKAGE.CANCEL_MESSAGE: Cancel "{{title}}" for this learner? Its unfinished journeys are cancelled too; completed ones and ones they already had stay.

CATALOG.TITLE: Catalog
CATALOG.SUB_LEARNER: Browse every journey and package. Enroll in what you need; your reviewer follows your progress.
CATALOG.SUB_STAFF: Every journey and package in one place. Assign straight from here.
CATALOG.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search by title, topic, tag or what you will learn…
CATALOG.EMPTY_SUB: Try another search, or clear the filters.
CATALOG.ENROLL_MESSAGE: {{reviewer}} will review your progress, notes and exams.
CATALOG.NO_REVIEWER: You have no senior or manager yet, so you can’t enroll yourself. Ask HR to set one.
CATALOG.NOT_FOUND: That catalog entry no longer exists.
CATALOG.STAFF_NOTE: Assign this to a learner you look after.

TEAM.TITLE: Your team
TEAM.SUB: Who needs a nudge, who is waiting on you, and where everyone stands.
TEAM.ALL_CLEAR: All clear — nothing is waiting on you.
TEAM.ATTN_NO_SENIOR: has no senior to review their work
TEAM.LEARNER_NOT_FOUND: That learner could not be opened.
TEAM.NOTHING_ASSIGNED_SUB: Pick a journey or package from the catalog to get them started.

DUE.LABEL: Due date
DUE.DEFAULT_HINT: Suggested from the expected duration ({{days}} days). Clear it for no deadline.
DUE.OPTIONAL_HINT: Optional. Leave empty for no deadline.
DUE.TARGET_HINT: Optional. Sets a due date this many days after it is assigned.
DUE.PACKAGE_TARGET_HINT: Optional. The whole package is due this many days after it is assigned.

HOME.NOTHING_NOW_SUB: Browse the catalog for something new, or check back after your reviewer responds.
HOME.WAIT_EXAM: Your exam for {{journey}} is waiting to be graded

LEARNER_1.TITLE: Welcome to Journey
LEARNER_1.BODY: Your onboarding is a set of journeys. Each one is made of units: things to read, watch or do, a short quiz at the end of each unit, and sometimes a final exam.

LEARNER_2.TITLE: Start from “Next up”
LEARNER_2.BODY: Your home page shows the one thing to do next, what else is your turn, and what is waiting on your reviewer.

LEARNER_3.TITLE: Work through a unit
LEARNER_3.BODY: Open an item and press Continue when you are done — your progress saves itself. Answer the unit’s quiz, and your reviewer checks the unit or replies with a note.

LEARNER_4.TITLE: Find more in the catalog
LEARNER_4.BODY: Browse the catalog — or press / anywhere to search. Preview the first unit of a journey, then enroll yourself. Your senior reviews your work.

LEARNER_5.TITLE: Stay in the loop
LEARNER_5.BODY: Announcements from HR and your manager sit at the top of your home, and the bell tells you about replies, reviews and due dates. Reopen this guide from the ? button.

SENIOR_1.TITLE: Welcome to Journey
SENIOR_1.BODY: You guide your learners through their onboarding journeys and review their work.

SENIOR_2.TITLE: Your team at a glance
SENIOR_2.BODY: Your home lists what needs your attention — items to review, exams to grade, notes to answer, learners who went quiet — and every learner’s progress.

SENIOR_3.TITLE: Review units
SENIOR_3.BODY: When a learner finishes a unit’s items and quiz, it waits for your review. Complete it, or send it back with a note. Grade written exam answers the same way.

SENIOR_4.TITLE: Build, preview and assign
SENIOR_4.BODY: Create journeys and packages under Journeys, use Preview to see exactly what learners get, then assign them with an optional due date.

MANAGER_1.TITLE: Welcome to Journey
MANAGER_1.BODY: You see every senior and learner in your department, and how their onboarding is going.

MANAGER_2.TITLE: Start with what needs attention
MANAGER_2.BODY: Your home shows overdue and at-risk learners, work waiting for review, and a searchable table of everyone. Click a learner to see their whole picture.

MANAGER_3.TITLE: Deadlines that nudge
MANAGER_3.BODY: Give journeys and packages an expected duration. Due dates are suggested when assigning, and reminders go out before and after they pass.

MANAGER_4.TITLE: Bundle with packages
MANAGER_4.BODY: A package groups journeys a role always needs. Assign it once; progress shows as one card and learners get a “next journey” button.

MANAGER_5.TITLE: Your people
MANAGER_5.BODY: Add people to your department under Users and give each learner a senior to review their work.

ORG_1.TITLE: Welcome to Journey
ORG_1.BODY: You see onboarding across every department, and can narrow any view to one.

ORG_2.TITLE: The whole organisation, flat
ORG_2.BODY: Your home shows who is overdue or at risk and what’s waiting for review. Pick a department to focus, or click a learner for their profile.

ORG_3.TITLE: Departments and people
ORG_3.BODY: Manage departments and accounts from the menu. Managers only ever see their own department.

ORG_4.TITLE: The library
ORG_4.BODY: Journeys and packages live under Journeys, with Preview to try them as a learner. Everyone can browse the catalog, and learners can enroll themselves.

ORG_5.TITLE: Deadlines and reminders
ORG_5.BODY: Expected durations become due dates when assigned. Learners and their assigners are reminded before and after a due date.

MANAGER_6.TITLE: Announcements
MANAGER_6.BODY: Post news for your department under Announcements. It appears at the top of everyone’s home until the date you choose, and they are notified.

ORG_6.TITLE: Announcements
ORG_6.BODY: Post to the whole company or to chosen departments under Announcements. It shows at the top of each person’s home, and they are notified in the app and by email.

LOG.EXAM_LOCKED: Opens when every unit is finished
LOG.QUIZ_INTRO: Answer every question to finish the unit. You’ll see your result straight away and can try again.
LOG.QUIZ_NOT_TAKEN: The learner hasn’t taken this quiz yet.
LOG.READY_HINT: Everything in this unit is done.
LOG.SEND_BACK_HINT: To send it back, set it to in progress and say what to change below.

ANNOUNCEMENTS.TITLE: Announcements
ANNOUNCEMENTS.SUB_ORG: Messages to the whole company or to departments. Current ones sit at the top of everyone's dashboard.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.SUB_MANAGER: Messages that reached your department. Current ones sit at the top of everyone's dashboard.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.EMPTY_CURRENT: No announcements are showing right now.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.DELETE_MESSAGE: It disappears from dashboards and its notifications are removed. This cannot be undone.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.DISMISS_FAILED: Could not remove the announcement. Try again.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.GONE: This announcement is no longer available.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.FORM_SUB: Everyone in the audience is notified in the app and by email, and it shows on their dashboard.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.TITLE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Office closed on National Day
ANNOUNCEMENTS.LINK_HINT: Tip: link to a page of this site (for example a catalog journey) and it opens right in the app.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.SHOW_UNTIL_HINT: Two weeks by default. People can also remove it from their own dashboard.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.NOTIFY_AGAIN: Notify everyone again about this edit
ANNOUNCEMENTS.NOTIFY_HINT: Publishing notifies the audience in the app and by email.

PREVIEW.NOT_FOUND: That journey could not be previewed.
PREVIEW.STAFF_NOTE: This is what learners see. Try the quizzes and the exam — nothing you do here is saved.
PREVIEW.LEARNER_NOTE: You are looking at the first unit as a sample. Enroll from the catalog to open the rest.
PREVIEW.LOCKED_BODY: This preview includes the first unit only.
PREVIEW.QUIZ_LOCKED: {{count}} quick questions to check what you learned — available after you enroll.
PREVIEW.RESULT: You got {{score}}% of the auto-graded questions right.
PREVIEW.OPEN_NOTE: Written answer — a reviewer marks this in a real attempt.

CERTIFICATE.NOT_FOUND: That certificate could not be opened.
CERTIFICATE.DOWNLOAD_HINT: Download PDF opens the print dialog — choose “Save as PDF” as the printer.
CERTIFICATE.COMPLETED_PACKAGE: has successfully completed the onboarding package

START.TITLE: Set up onboarding for your people

SENIORS.TITLE: Add seniors to your department
SENIORS.HINT: Seniors review learners’ work. Add at least one under Users.

LEARNERS_HAVE_SENIOR.TITLE: Give every learner a senior
LEARNERS_HAVE_SENIOR.HINT: A learner without a senior has nobody to review their units.

ASSIGNED.TITLE: Assign a first journey or package
ASSIGNED.HINT: Pick one under Journeys — Preview shows what learners will get.

DUE_DATES.TITLE: Set due dates on open journeys
DUE_DATES.HINT: Due dates drive reminders and the overdue list. Edit them from a learner’s journey.

ANNOUNCEMENT.TITLE: Post an announcement
ANNOUNCEMENT.HINT: Welcome your team or share news; it tops everyone’s dashboard.

HAS_LEARNERS.TITLE: Have learners assigned to you
HAS_LEARNERS.HINT: Your manager links learners to you under Users.

ASSIGNED.TITLE: Assign a journey to a learner
ASSIGNED.HINT: Pick one under Journeys — use Preview to check it first.

DUE_DATES.TITLE: Set due dates on open journeys
DUE_DATES.HINT: Due dates drive reminders and the overdue list.

REVIEWED_UNIT.TITLE: Review a unit
REVIEWED_UNIT.HINT: When a learner finishes a unit it appears in your attention list; complete it or send it back.

DEPARTMENTS_HAVE_MANAGER.TITLE: Give every department a manager
DEPARTMENTS_HAVE_MANAGER.HINT: Managers see and support their department’s onboarding.

LEARNERS_HAVE_SENIOR.TITLE: Give every learner a senior
LEARNERS_HAVE_SENIOR.HINT: Learners without a senior have nobody to review their work.

PACKAGE.TITLE: Bundle journeys into a package
PACKAGE.HINT: A package is the onboarding a role always needs, assigned in one go.

EVERYONE_ASSIGNED.TITLE: Make sure every learner has something assigned
EVERYONE_ASSIGNED.HINT: The team dashboard lists learners with nothing assigned.

ORG_ANNOUNCEMENT.TITLE: Post a company-wide announcement
ORG_ANNOUNCEMENT.HINT: Share news with everyone; it tops each person’s dashboard.

NOT_FOUND.TITLE: Page not found
NOT_FOUND.HINT: The address may be mistyped, or what it pointed to was removed.

FORBIDDEN.TITLE: You don't have access to this
FORBIDDEN.HINT: This belongs to someone outside your reach. Ask your manager or HR if you need it.

FAILED.TITLE: This page couldn't load
FAILED.HINT: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

SESSION.IDLE: You were signed out after 5 minutes without activity. Sign in to continue where you left off.
SESSION.EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Sign in to continue where you left off.
